business_summary: Mitsubishi Estate Co., Ltd. engages in real estate activities in Japan and internationally. The company develops, leases, manages, and sells office buildings and commercial facilities; operates rental offices, coworking spaces, virtual offices, hourly meeting rooms, home delivery storage services, commercial nursing homes, and building garages; offers real estate management, as well as building management services, such as security, facility management, cleaning, and planting services; and operates hotels and airports. It also engages in the construction, sales, management, and leasing of developed condominiums and residential houses; design and contract construction of custom-built houses; renovation and sales of condominiums, detached houses, overseas business, investment management; real estate brokerage; dark fiber leasing and data center housing business; provision of real estate investment, such as asset management services to investment corporations and real estate funds; architectural design and engineering business; cooling and heating supply business; delivery and takeout; and parking management business. In addition, the company leases, operates, and manages logistics facilities; sells gasoline products; purchases, manufactures, processes, and sells construction materials; constructs prefabricated housing using cross-laminated timber and laminated wood; constructs, manufactures, and sells furniture and household items; offers financial consulting and investment advisory services; and develops and manages information systems and software. Further, it plans, develops, and operates Ele-Cinema, an elevator projection type media solution; and Machi Pass FACE, a collaboration platform that enables facial recognition services. Additionally, the company offers human resources, land management, and landscaping services. Mitsubishi Estate Co., Ltd. was founded in 1890 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Mitsubishi Estate Co., Ltd.는 일본 및 해외에서 부동산 활동에 종사하고 있습니다. 회사는 사무용 건물 및 상업 시설을 개발, 임대, 관리 및 판매합니다. 임대 사무실, 공동 작업 공간, 가상 사무실, 시간별 회의실, 택배 보관 서비스, 상업용 요양원 및 건물 차고를 운영합니다. 부동산 관리는 물론 보안, 시설 관리, 청소, 식재 서비스 등 건물 관리 서비스도 제공합니다. 호텔과 공항을 운영하고 있습니다. 또한 개발된 콘도미니엄과 주거용 주택의 건설, 판매, 관리 및 임대에도 참여합니다. 맞춤형 주택의 설계 및 계약 건설; 콘도미니엄, 단독주택의 개조 및 판매, 해외 사업, 투자 관리; 부동산 중개; 다크 파이버 임대 및 데이터 센터 주택 사업; 투자법인 및 부동산펀드에 대한 자산관리 서비스 등 부동산 투자 제공 건축 설계 및 엔지니어링 사업; 냉난방 공급업; 배달 및 테이크아웃; 주차관리사업 등을 하고 있습니다. 또한 회사는 물류시설을 임대, 운영, 관리하는 업무를 수행하고 있습니다.
